args.intro: If you love Tems, you'll feel right at home with these smooth, soulful alté and Afro-fusion grooves. Here is a curated set sharing her signature chilled, expressive sound.
args.closing: Put this on repeat and let the smooth grooves carry your vibe.

picks.why: Straight from Tems herself, this track showcases her signature dreamy vocals over a calm, mid-tempo groove.
Burna Boy delivers a mellow, warm Afro-fusion vibe with silky instrumentation that matches Tems's laid-back energy.
Coming out of the same Nigerian alté movement, BOJ brings a relaxed, groovy beat and effortlessly soulful feel.
Fireboy DML serves up an easygoing afrobeats rhythm packed with uplifting vocal melodies and smooth warmth.
A pioneer of the alté sound alongside Tems, Odunsi crafts a sleek, late-night atmosphere with smooth R&B textures.
